models.name: todo_app_configurations
models.description:
Core application configuration settings with version control and audit trail support.

Stores the master configuration definitions including metadata, validation rules, and default values. Each configuration entry represents a configurable parameter that can be customized per environment while maintaining a consistent definition structure.

Supports typed configuration values with proper validation, dependency tracking, and hierarchical organization. Configuration changes are tracked through snapshots to maintain audit trails and enable rollback capabilities.

The table enforces data integrity through unique constraints and supports flexible configuration management for multi-environment deployments.

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration key identifier following naming convention: 'category.subcategory.setting'. Must be lowercase with underscores.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable display name for the configuration setting.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description explaining the purpose, usage, and impact of this configuration.

plainFields.name: data_type
plainFields.description: Expected data type for configuration values: 'boolean', 'number', 'string', 'json', 'array', 'object'.

plainFields.name: default_value
plainFields.description: Default configuration value that applies when no environment-specific value is set.

plainFields.name: validation_rules
plainFields.description: JSON string containing validation constraints for the configuration value.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Configuration category for organizational grouping (e.g., 'security', 'performance', 'ui').

plainFields.name: is_sensitive
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this configuration contains sensitive information that requires encryption.

plainFields.name: is_required
plainFields.description: Whether this configuration must have a value set in all environments.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Configuration version number for tracking schema changes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration definition was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration definition was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration was soft-deleted, allowing for recovery.

models.name: todo_app_configuration_snapshots
models.description:
Historical snapshots of configuration changes for audit trails and version control.

Captures point-in-time states of configuration definitions whenever changes are made. Each snapshot represents a complete configuration definition at a specific moment, enabling rollback capabilities and change tracking.

Used for compliance auditing, troubleshooting configuration-related issues, and understanding the evolution of application settings over time. Snapshots are append-only and never modified after creation.

Maintains referential integrity with the main configuration table while providing independent historical records for analysis and reporting.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_configuration_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the configuration definition being snapshotted. {@link todo_app_configurations.id}

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description: Configuration key at the time of snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Configuration display name at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Configuration description at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: data_type
plainFields.description: Data type definition at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: default_value
plainFields.description: Default value at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: validation_rules
plainFields.description: Validation rules at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Configuration category at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: is_sensitive
plainFields.description: Sensitivity flag at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: is_required
plainFields.description: Required flag at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Configuration version at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: snapshot_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for creating this snapshot (e.g., 'version_update', 'bug_fix', 'compliance').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.

models.name: todo_app_configuration_values
models.description:
Environment-specific configuration values that override default settings.

Stores actual configuration values for specific deployment environments (development, staging, production). Each value entry links to a configuration definition and provides the environment-specific implementation of that setting.

Supports value versioning and audit trails for environment-specific configurations. Values can be set, modified, or deleted independently per environment while maintaining referential integrity with the master configuration definitions.

Enables flexible configuration management across multiple deployment environments with proper isolation and change tracking.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_configuration_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the configuration definition. {@link todo_app_configurations.id}

plainFields.name: environment
plainFields.description: Deployment environment for this configuration value (e.g., 'development', 'staging', 'production').

plainFields.name: config_value
plainFields.description: Environment-specific configuration value that overrides the default.

plainFields.name: value_type
plainFields.description: Type of the stored value for validation purposes.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this environment-specific value is currently active.

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration value becomes effective.

plainFields.name: effective_to
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration value expires (null for indefinite).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration value was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration value was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration value was soft-deleted.

models.name: mv_todo_app_active_configurations
models.description:
Materialized view showing currently active configuration values across all environments.

Pre-computed view that combines configuration definitions with their active environment-specific values. Provides fast access to the complete configuration state without complex joins and filtering logic.

Used by application components that need to quickly access the current configuration settings. The view is refreshed periodically to ensure consistency with the underlying configuration tables.

Optimizes configuration lookup performance for high-frequency access patterns in the application runtime.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_configuration_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the configuration definition. {@link todo_app_configurations.id}

foreignFields.name: todo_app_configuration_value_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the active configuration value. {@link todo_app_configuration_values.id}

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description: Configuration key identifier.

plainFields.name: environment
plainFields.description: Deployment environment.

plainFields.name: effective_value
plainFields.description: Currently active configuration value (environment-specific or default).

plainFields.name: value_source
plainFields.description: Source of the value: 'environment' for specific values, 'default' for fallback.

plainFields.name: data_type
plainFields.description: Expected data type for validation.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Configuration category for filtering.

plainFields.name: is_sensitive
plainFields.description: Whether the value contains sensitive information.

plainFields.name: last_updated
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration was last updated.

models.name: todo_app_users
models.description:
User accounts for the Todo application.

Stores user authentication information, profile data, and account status for individuals managing their personal todo lists. Each user has a unique email address and secure password authentication, along with a display name for personalization.

Users can create, read, update, and delete their own todo items while maintaining complete data isolation from other users. The system supports user verification workflows, account status management, and activity tracking through last login timestamps.

User accounts support soft deletion for data recovery scenarios while maintaining comprehensive audit trails of account lifecycle events and authentication activities.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's unique email address used for authentication and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for user authentication using industry-standard algorithms.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: User's display name for personalization and identification in the application.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current user account status. Valid business values: active, suspended, verified, pending_verification, locked.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the user's most recent successful login for activity tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description:
User session records for authentication tracking and security management.

Stores active user sessions for secure access to the Todo application. Each session represents an authenticated connection from a user's device, containing comprehensive connection context information for audit and security purposes.

Sessions are automatically created during successful login and track connection details including IP address, user agent, and referrer information. The system maintains session state securely and validates authentication tokens on each API request.

Sessions require independent management capabilities including search across all users, expiration tracking, and security monitoring. Users and administrators need to view and manage active sessions for security compliance.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the connection that created this session for security tracking.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string identifying the device and browser used for this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was established.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that directed the user to the application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired or was terminated.

plainFields.name: last_activity_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent activity in this session for timeout tracking.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Core todo items created and managed by authenticated users.

Stores individual todo tasks with text descriptions and completion status tracking.
Each todo belongs to exactly one user and maintains creation and modification timestamps
for audit purposes. The design follows minimal principles with only essential fields
required for basic todo functionality.

Todos support soft deletion through the deleted_at field while maintaining data integrity
for historical tracking. The completion status allows users to track task progress
without complex workflow management.

plainFields.name: text
plainFields.description: Todo item description text. Must be between 1-500 characters as specified in requirements.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Completion status indicating whether the todo item is finished. Defaults to false (incomplete).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was originally created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was soft deleted. Null indicates active item.
